title: Telecommunications (Customer Service Guarantee) Standard 2023
converter: cth_convert_sym_v10.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used docx_text() of workbench harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py: word/document.xml paragraphs one per line (table cells included, one per line), table-of-contents paragraphs dropped, Chapter/Part/Division headings as '\tPart N — Title'; images (formulas, figures) are not converted

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-23 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of F2026C00929 (download_sha256 123b36fa09dc0e5505fcd7ec270d61d87300ab3fa8eac2f9c2f89f77c6d9e906, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: The Standard writes three em dashes as Symbol-font w:sym elements (F0BE), which docx_text() dropped, and types its list markers as text in the Symbol font, which docx_text() kept as raw private-use code points (U+F0B7) that display as empty boxes. cth_convert_sym_v10.py maps both to Unicode (and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]"); run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 19 lines changed (same 702 lines): 16 bullets (U+F0B7 -> •) at lines 92-93, 95-97 and 99-109 (Notes 1 and 2 to the definitions: the terms defined in the Act and in the Telecommunications Act 1997); 3 em dashes restored at line 71 (definition of interim service, (a)(ii): 'with a disability — a service equivalent'), line 546 (Schedule 1 item 202(c): '... but not more than 2 500 — within 15 business days') and line 547 (item 202(d): '... to be connected — within 15 business days'). At line 71 the no-break space the Word text has before the dash is now kept (the first conversion had merged it with the following space). No word or number changed.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: No encoding of this subject. telecommunications-consumer-protection-and-service-standards-act-1999/encodings/baseline-2026-10 (tcpss-csg-standard.l4) reads Schedule 1 item 202(c) and (d) (15 business days) and relies on the interim-service definition through Schedule 2 item 101(2); only the dashes changed on those lines, so no rule, case, value or finding changed. No other file records the text hash; the subject has no formulas sidecar.
